messages:
sasha: Follow-up on transport/pager retry decisions for v2 SDKs. Need small, implementable handshake we can ship. Proposals: opaque resume tokens, server-flagged resumability, adapters per-lang plus canonical spec.

ben: Opaque tokens + server resumable flag = yes. Clients treat token as blob.

lina: For retries: unary idempotent ops auto-retry with exp backoff (base=100ms, max=4s, attempts=4). Paged/streamed: no auto-retry unless resumable=true and resume_token present.

mark: For TS/Py ergonomics: async iterator paginator with .resume(token) method. Go: Pager struct with Resume(token) and Next(ctx).

sasha: Transport shape: publish HTTP-based canonical spec (method, path, headers, body) and allow language adapters. Advanced transports can implement Stream/Do.

ben: Add infra guard: warn if resume token >2k, reject >8k. Also don't log full token; redact in SDK by default.

ci-bot: Created issue #4400 "v2 SDK transport + pagination handshake".
